level: native Agent cancellation receipt evidence and ownership fixtures
observed: Terminal shell/desktop/browser/worktree status alone cannot prove an external process or helper stopped; strict original boolean stopConfirmed or notStarted evidence is required.

Missing, false, numeric and string pseudo-boolean evidence, unknown and nonterminal states remain unconfirmed; operation ownership is enforced and the original receipt is never rewritten by the response.
A failed shell with null result does not falsely confirm or release its workspace admission; a forged success while an in-process file write remains active is also not confirmed.
limitations: This change reports evidence; it does not create an OS sandbox or prove the entire product Task command facade safe.
Legacy native command results without explicit stop evidence, as well as other external operations lacking proof, now conservatively return false even when the operation row is terminal.

A successful in-process fs_write retains true only after its tracked job and controller have ended; other writes without proof are not assumed stopped. Existing external-writer and parent/leaf path races remain open.
Remote tests verified 18 matching source files in isolated fixtures, not the entire repository or a full remote-machine product deployment.
